messages:
lina (Support): Heads-up — BrightCart reported a regression after yesterday's model rollout. They say function calls are either missing or receiving empty/wrong args. Ticket #BC-482. Copying the initial customer snippet:

brightcart-bot: Customer message -> 'since the update, our price-check tool is no longer being invoked reliably. The product sku arg is often empty or missing. Examples attached.' :warning:

lina (Support): Minimal repro (from customer):
```json
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-chat-2.3",
  "input": "Find price for sku: 12345",
  "functions": [
    {
      "name": "fetch_price",
      "parameters": { "sku": { "type": "string" } }
    }
  ]
}
```
Response (expected): function_call to fetch_price with sku=12345
Response (actual): just text, or function_call with sku: """ or sometimes args: { }

matt (ML Eng): :eyes: thanks. Do you have the request_id or trace id from the API logs? Also which rollout id was applied and to which cluster/region?

lina (Support): Request IDs from customer: rcv_98f1, rcv_98f7, rcv_992c. Rollout id attached in ticket: rollout-2026-03-09-22:00-canary (sha: a3f9c). Region: us-east-1 (hosted). No HTTP error codes — 200s, just wrong semantic output.

jules (Releases): That rollout included the new function-calling heuristic change (FC-heuristic-v2) that biases for textual responses when confidence < 0.6. It was enabled for 10% canary on hosted initially and auto-bumped to 50% overnight.

matt (ML Eng): That lines up — FC-heuristic-v2 had a bug where the argument extractor drops arguments for short prompts if tokenization boundary shifts. Reproducing locally now. Can you paste the full raw request payload + headers (customer sanitized)?

lina (Support): Pasted from ticket (sanitized):
```http
POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "redwood-chat-2.3",
  "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Price for sku 12345" }],
  "functions": [ { "name": "fetch_price", "parameters": { "sku": { "type": "string" } } } ],
  "temperature": 0.0
}
```
Response from customer (one example):
```json
{
  "id": "rcv_98f1",
  "output": {
    "type": "message",
    "content": "The price is $X (see attached)."
  }
}
```
No function_call field present.

matt (ML Eng): Repro steps I ran: same payload against canary variant, got either function_call with empty args or plain text. Looks deterministic for short, single-token numeric skus. Suspect arg parsing off by one when tokenizer merges digits with punctuation. Creating minimal test harness.

tony (SRE): Metrics: around rollout time we saw a jump in model-level "non-function responses" rate from 2% -> 24% for that model/version in us-east-1. No CPU/GPU infra anomalies. Latency stable.

jules (Releases): Can we pause the canary bump? I can throttle it back to 10% or roll back if needed.

lina (Support): Customer is asking for a quick mitigation — they rely on function calls for commerce flow. Any hotfix ETA?

matt (ML Eng): Short-term mitigations: 1) pin BrightCart to previous model variant (redwood-chat-2.2-compat) via customer route override; 2) force gateway to always return function_call if user input matches regex pattern (cheap proxy fix); 3) rollback FC-heuristic-v2 canary. I recommend pin first, then rollback.

jules (Releases): I rolled the canary back from 50% -> 10% at 16:40 UTC. Also opened rollback ticket ROLLBACK-1123. Can we coordinate pin by CS?

anya (Customer Success): I’ve reached BrightCart and requested permission to pin their workspace to redwood-chat-2.2-compat. They approved. Applying now.

lina (Support): Doing the pin — workspace: brightcart-prod pinned to redwood-chat-2.2-compat. Notifying customer.

brightcart-bot: Customer updated -> 'Thanks, pinning to v2.2 fixed the checkout automation — tool calls are back. Please keep us posted on root cause.' :relieved:

matt (ML Eng): Thanks. I have a local fix for the tokenizer boundary; will run unit tests across tokenization edgecases for numeric and punctuation-heavy args. If green, I can prepare patch to FC-heuristic-v2 and request redeploy to canary only.

jules (Releases): Keep the canary at 10% until patch lands and we run regression suite.

matt (ML Eng): Filed BUG-7832 (function-calling arg extraction: numeric token boundary bug). Patch branch: fix/fc-arg-numeric-boundary. Primary tests added: sku-like tokens, phone, currency, punctuation.

lina (Support): Logging notes for support triage: look for responses with no "function_call" key or function_call.args == {} where messages include numeric tokens. Also check request ids rcv_98f1 etc.

tony (SRE): Adding a Grafana alert (panel: function_call_rate_drop) with threshold if function_call rate drops >10% delta over 5m. This should catch regressions earlier.

matt (ML Eng): Patch passed unit tests locally. Running internal QA now, then will request canary deploy to 5% with extra logging for arg extraction.

jules (Releases): Sounds good. I'll hold on any further canary expansion until we see QA results.

anya (Customer Success): BrightCart confirmed flows are green after pin. They're content with pinning but would like an ETA for general fix before we unpin.

matt (ML Eng): ETA: 48 hours for patch + canary verification if no regressions. Will post patch PR and test results here.

lina (Support): Assigning follow-ups: Lina -> confirm with customer when fix is fully rolled; Matt -> submit PR + QA results; Jules -> prevent canary bump and coordinate rollback if needed; Tony -> keep alert enabled.

brightcart-bot: Customer final -> 'Appreciate the quick response. Please let us know when we can unpin.' :thumbsup:

lina (Support): Closing loop for now. If anyone finds more customer repros, drop them here.

(THREAD ENDS)
